rows.scope: Heavy vehicles over 4.5 t GVM restricted to 100 km/h under Australian Design Rule 65/00 speed-limiter rules, state road rules and the Heavy Vehicle National Law.
Royal Decree of 1 December 1975 (Highway Code Art. 11.2): vehicles and combinations over 3.5 t MAM limited to 90 km/h on motorways, aligned with EU Directive 2002/85/EC speed limiters.
Brazilian Traffic Code (Lei 9.503/1997, Art. 61 para. 1 II a/b, unchanged for heavy vehicles by Lei 14.440/2022): 90 km/h default highway limit for trucks and buses ('demais veiculos').
Ontario Highway Traffic Act s. 68.1 and Quebec Highway Safety Code s. 519.15.1 mandatory electronic speed limiters capped at 105 km/h for heavy commercial vehicles >= 11,794 kg GVWR.

State Council Decree No. 405 (Regulation on the Implementation of the Road Traffic Safety Law of the PRC, Art. 78): 100 km/h maximum speed on expressways for motor vehicles other than small passenger cars.
Real Decreto 1428/2003 (Reglamento General de Circulacion, Art. 48.1.a): 90 km/h on autopistas and autovias for trucks over 3,500 kg MMA and articulated vehicles.
Code de la route Art. R413-8: 90 km/h on motorways for goods vehicles and combinations over 3.5 t PTAC/PTRA, aligned with EU Directive 2002/85/EC speed limiters.
Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986 Reg. 36B implementing Directive 2002/85/EC: mandatory speed limiter set to 90 km/h (56 mph) for goods vehicles over 3.5 t.
Road Traffic (Ordinary Speed Limits - Buses, Heavy Goods Vehicles, Etc.) Regulations 2008 (S.I. No. 546/2008): 90 km/h ordinary motorway speed limit for HGVs over 3,500 kg.
Common cap covering the model's combined lorry and bus classes. Trailers remain at 80 km/h; the 90 km/h allowance for rigid large goods vehicles is not applied to the whole mixed class.
Vehicles over 3500 kg on the open road; school buses retain 80 km/h.
Government Decree No. 1090 of 23 October 1993 (Traffic Rules of the Russian Federation, s. 10.3): 90 km/h on motorways for goods vehicles over 3.5 t.
FMCSA/NHTSA joint NPRM (81 FR 61942) documenting interstate heavy-truck fleet speed-limiter practice around 65 mph (105 km/h) alongside state differential truck speed limits.
